input.oldString:
install_propscan() {
    print_status "Installing PropScan..."
    
    # Install using the detected pip command
    if [ -n "$PIP_CMD" ]; then
        $PIP_CMD install --user -e .
    elif command -v pip3 &> /dev/null; then
        pip3 install --user -e .
    elif command -v pip &> /dev/null; then
        pip install --user -e .
    else
        python3 -m pip install --user -e .
    fi
    
    print_success "PropScan installed successfully!"
}
input.newString:
install_propscan() {
    print_status "Installing PropScan in virtual environment..."
    
    # Make sure we're in the virtual environment
    if [ -z "$VIRTUAL_ENV" ]; then
        print_error "Virtual environment not activated!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Install PropScan in the virtual environment
    python -m pip install -e .
    
    print_success "PropScan installed successfully in virtual environment!"
}

create_wrapper_script() {
    print_status "Creating wrapper script..."
    
    # Create local bin directory if it doesn't exist
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    
    # Create wrapper script
    cat > "$HOME/.local/bin/propscan" << EOF
#!/bin/bash
# PropScan wrapper script - activates venv and runs propscan

# Activate the virtual environment
source "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate"

# Run propscan with all arguments
exec python -m propscan "\$@"
EOF
    
    # Make the wrapper script executable
    chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
    
    print_success "Wrapper script created at $HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
}
